## 2. Current status
- 2026-07-29/30: The last qualifying US strike I could confirm. CENTCOM reported finishing a wave of strikes at about 10 p.m. ET on July 29, in retaliation for an Iranian "attempted surprise attack" on US forces in Jordan. Al Jazeera reported a "heavy wave" hitting Qeshm and Bushehr. Iranian media said a strike on a house in Qeshm killed three people. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/us-hits-multiple-targets-in-iran-as-irgc-pledges-retaliation-what-we-know), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/30/nx-s1-5913077/us-iran-updates), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-07-30/news-1Pcg2L8su6k/p.html)

- 2026-08-01: CNN said no US strikes inside Iran had been reported in several days. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/01/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- I found no reported US strike on Iranian territory between July 31 and August 8. Nothing has settled the question yet.

- 2026-08-03: Trump said talks would start Monday and called it Iran's "last chance". [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/8/3/iran-war-live-trump-says-talks-set-to-begin-tehran-urges-us-to-honour-mou)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-07-07 to 07-23: The US struck Iran almost nightly. CENTCOM reported its 13th consecutive night of strikes on July 23. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4554310/us-concludes-13th-night-of-strikes-on-iranian-military-targets/)
- 2026-07-24 to 07-28: A five-night pause was broken by retaliation for an Iranian attack on US forces.
- 2026-06-17 to 07-07: The Islamabad ceasefire memorandum held for about three weeks before collapsing over shipping. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-update.htm)
- Trump has announced pauses many times (in March, and again on Aug 1), and strikes often resumed afterwards. [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/amp/politics/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening)

- **Iran-Oman Hormuz framework:** The draft still needs approval from Iran's parliament and the Supreme Leader. Iran's denial of US talks could prompt Trump to drop the "rapid deal" condition and resume strikes.

- **Aug 17:** The Islamabad memorandum is reportedly due to expire on this date, per the GlobalSecurity tracker. That source's dates are inconsistent, so treat this as unverified.
